sources.entry: SonarQube | Continuous inspection of code quality

summary.one_liner: Official Docker image repository for running a self-managed SonarQube (Community Build and commercial editions) server in a container for code quality and security analysis.
summary.what_it_does: This repo is the Git source for SonarSource's official SonarQube Docker image, which runs a SonarQube server in a container so scanners can send analysis results to it. It publishes versioned tags for the Community Build and supported commercial editions. The README points to Docker Compose examples for common setups and a generator for SonarQube Server with agentic components. The full user-facing Docker Hub readme is maintained in the docker-library/docs project rather than in this repo. The README also describes the wider SonarQube product line (Cloud, IDE plugin, MCP Server, CLI) without detailing their setup here.
use_cases: run a self-hosted code quality server in Docker
inspect code for bugs and security issues in CI pipelines
pin a specific SonarQube version for testing or production
set up SonarQube with Docker Compose
review quality gate results for a project
notable: Official SonarQube images maintained by SonarSource, with versioned tags
Docker Compose examples and a generator for SonarQube Server with agentic components
Covers Community Build plus commercial Server editions from one repo
Full usage documentation lives in the docker-library/docs project
caveats: Contributions are limited to minor improvements and bug fixes; feature requests go to the SonarSource forum
Full usage documentation is hosted elsewhere (docker-library/docs), not in this README
Commercial editions are under SonarQube Server Terms and Conditions
